text: Implemented on work/claude-w01: RealStudyBackendSuite 'cancelling a real run settles it within 500 ms and commits no later step' (latency budget 500 ms named in the test; job state unchanged after cancel; subscription reports no step beyond the cancelled run's last progress; Finished frame last). 31/31 in three consecutive local runs. A first version comparing with the first subscribed step failed legitimately (subscriptions are conflated: step 22 seen, 38 at cancel) and was replaced. Watch the 500 ms budget on hosted runners.
